disposition_mapping.rationale: Document assembly is pure ERP retrieval with no judgment content and carries no step-preservation requirement; the council converged (with emerging_economy and hitl_designer conceding their initial objections) that it should become the automated entry action of the matching step rather than a standalone human task. The function is preserved, not discarded: the assembled, linked document set remains retrievable as the evidential basis for cost (KB-09), and an explicit assembly-status flag (complete/incomplete/low-confidence) is carried forward as a first-class, escalatable artifact so degraded source data in non-head-office contexts is caught rather than silently absorbed. A batch/offline execution path is preserved alongside event-triggered retrieval.

Quantity matching is deterministic comparison of structured data; no requirement protects it as a discrete human-operated step, only as a function with its required input. It is merged into the automated matching pass but survives as a separately logged, separately timestamped artifact (quantity variance detail), satisfying TWM-R-01 (function preserved) and TWM-R-03 (goods receipt note data remains a direct, mandatory input, not a derived or cached proxy, per accounting_standards' KB-09 concern).

Price and terms matching is likewise deterministic comparison; it is merged into the same automated pass as quantity matching for the same reason (no sequential human review gate separates the two comparisons), but produces a distinct, separately logged artifact (price and terms variance detail, with an explicit exchange-difference tag per KB-08) so that root cause remains diagnosable and FX noise cannot be absorbed invisibly into tolerance bands. Satisfies TWM-R-02 (function preserved) and TWM-R-04 (purchase order data remains a direct mandatory input).

The council converged, after maximalist's initial folding and subsequent concession, that tolerance evaluation must keep its own step boundary even though it can execute automatically: it is the application of a human-owned risk-appetite policy to the comparison output, not a further arithmetic step, and it is the single routing signal the rest of the pipeline keys off. Restructured as TS-02 with the tolerance policy retained as an explicit, versioned, visible input (satisfying TWM-R-05 and TWM-R-06) and the classification and policy version both logged, so policy drift is independently auditable from the matching computation underneath it.

Six of seven council members independently converged on rejecting any autonomous disposition of exceptions, including maximalist's eventual full concession: an exception is by construction the case the deterministic engine and governed policy could not resolve, so it is the one population where judgment, not pattern-matching, is required regardless of how routine it appears historically. TS-03 preserves exception investigation and resolution as a human-decided, human-accountable function (satisfying TWM-R-10) with evidence intact, restructured only to add agent-assisted evidence retrieval as a research aid with no write or decision authority over the accept/correct/reject outcome.

Resolved in favour of the majority position (finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, accounting_standards, maximalist) over pragmatist's per-invoice-human-touch holdout: clean/in-tolerance matches release automatically under standing delegated authority with mandatory sampling and a reversible kill-switch, discharging accountability architecturally rather than ceremonially, while exception-resolved and override matches still require explicit human supervisor approval. This satisfies TWM-R-07 (approval function survives), TWM-R-08 (ordering structurally enforced -- release cannot act on an unresolved exception), and TWM-R-09 (actor separation enforced at the system/permission layer, not merely procedurally, per hitl_designer's and finance_domain's concession).

Although unconstrained by the requirement set, this step is not unconstrained by accounting-standards obligations: accounting_standards' KB-03 cutoff-enforceability point was unaddressed by other members and is adopted here in full, requiring explicit period-cutoff tagging on every match control record. The step is restructured from periodic batch compilation into continuous monitoring, and -- per hitl_designer's and emerging_economy's shared point -- is given materially more substantive work than before: mandatory statistical sampling and re-review of the auto-released clean-lane population, since that population no longer receives per-invoice human review and sampling is now the sole remaining backstop on the automation created by TS-04. A batch/offline reporting mode is preserved alongside continuous monitoring.

steps.actor: Matching automation engine, with AP analyst oversight of flagged data-quality exceptions
steps.description: An automated matching engine is triggered on arrival of a validated invoice record, retrieves the corresponding purchase order and goods receipt note from the ERP (event-triggered or scheduled/batch, to support constrained-connectivity sites), and flags assembly status as complete, incomplete or low-confidence before proceeding -- an incomplete or low-confidence flag routes the item directly to exception handling rather than silently proceeding. In the same automated pass the engine performs deterministic line-level quantity comparison against goods receipt data and price/terms comparison against purchase order data, writing two separately timestamped, separately retrievable artifacts -- quantity variance detail and price and terms variance detail -- rather than a single composite score, so that diagnostic root cause (receiving-side vs vendor/PO-side) remains distinguishable downstream. Where invoice and purchase order currencies differ, price/terms variance detail carries an explicit exchange-difference tag so FX movement is never absorbed invisibly into a generic price-variance figure. The underlying invoice-PO-GRN document linkage is retained and exportable, independent of the vendor matching tool, as the evidential basis for cost measurement.
steps.name: Automated match execution and variance detection
outputs: Assembled and linked match document set (retrievable, human-readable)
Price and terms variance detail (with exchange-difference tag where applicable)

steps.actor: Tolerance classification engine, with AP supervisor as accountable policy owner
steps.description: Quantity and price/terms variance detail are evaluated against the organisation's tolerance policy to classify the match as clean, within tolerance, or an exception. This remains a distinct step boundary -- deliberately not folded into TS-01 -- because it is the one point in the pipeline where a human-owned risk-appetite artifact, not document geometry, determines the outcome, and it is the authoritative routing signal for everything downstream. The classification engine executes automatically, but the tolerance policy is a versioned, governed configuration object that an accountable control owner (AP supervisor) sets and periodically re-approves; every classification output records which policy version was applied, so policy drift is independently visible and auditable from the arithmetic underneath it.
steps.name: Automated tolerance classification under governed policy

steps.actor: AP analyst, with agent-assisted evidence retrieval (no write/decision authority)
steps.description: Matches classified as exceptions are investigated and resolved. A decision-support agent may retrieve vendor correspondence, prior resolution history and similar past exceptions, and propose a disposition with a confidence rating and cited evidence, but the accept/correct/reject decision and its evidentiary basis is produced by a named, accountable AP analyst for every exception, without exception -- no confidence threshold permits autonomous disposition. This line was held by the overwhelming majority of the council: an exception is, by construction, the case the deterministic engine and governed tolerance policy could not resolve, so it is definitionally the population requiring human judgment, not a volume-efficiency opportunity. The interface requires the analyst to engage with the underlying evidence rather than single-click accepting a system suggestion, so the control is a real decision rather than a reflexive approval.
steps.name: Exception investigation and resolution

steps.actor: Release control system (clean/in-tolerance lane); AP supervisor (exception and override lane)
steps.description: Clean and in-tolerance matches release automatically for posting and payment under the AP supervisor's standing delegated authority, as a logged, reversible action with a kill-switch/claw-back path available before funds leave, and the auto-released population subject to mandatory statistical sampling review (see TS-05). Any match that passed through exception resolution, or involves an override of standard tolerance, requires explicit human approval by the AP supervisor, who reviews the variance detail, the resolution evidence and the resolver's identity before releasing. Ordering is structurally enforced: a release attempt cannot proceed for a match still carrying an unresolved exception flag. Actor separation is structurally enforced, not merely documented: the system rejects a release attempt where the releasing identity matches the identity of the analyst who resolved the exception on that invoice. This design was adopted over the alternative of a universal per-invoice human click because accountability for the clean lane is discharged through governed policy ownership, logging and population-level sampling rather than through a reviewer rubber-stamping matches the engine already certified against a versioned policy.
steps.name: Risk-based match release control

steps.description: Match outcomes, tolerance overrides, policy-version changes and exception resolutions are logged continuously to the control record rather than compiled on a fixed batch cycle, with a genuine batch/offline execution path preserved for sites without reliable live connectivity. Because release is now risk-based rather than universally human-reviewed, this step carries materially more weight than the baseline's periodic reporting: it must perform substantive, mandatory sampling and re-review of the auto-released clean-lane population to confirm the tolerance logic is still behaving as configured, not merely tally exception counts. Every match control record entry carries an explicit period-cutoff tag for match completion and release, so period-end gates and subledger locks have a concrete attribute to act on. Override-rate and sampling-exception thresholds trigger an active escalation to a named human reviewer rather than relying on someone remembering to check a report.
steps.name: Continuous match control monitoring and reporting
